newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: KL palm oil ends firmer on supportive export data.
newsitem.headline: KL palm oil ends firmer on supportive export data.

text.p: PALM OIL FUTURES PALM OIL PHYSICALS

PALM OIL FUTURES - A neutral official June crop report had little impact on the market which firmed at the close on supportive July 1-15 exports data. Firmer soyoil also aided prices. Technical buying appeared after Sept futures rose above the 1,150 rgt. Next resistance is 1,180 and support is 1,140.
PALM OIL PHYSICALS - Also saw more buying from refiners and interest was seen selective products and nearby CPOs.
